People have looked at what we Rosicrucian students teach, which are traditions like the Maori "way of knowing" and from the outside it looks like we are teaching against Science. However, every year our teachings are reviewed by top scientists in their fields and updated. Tweet by @RichardDawkins

https://x.com/RichardDawkins/status/1631210601350574082

1631505875201404929.a: Our purpose, in my personal opinion, is to preserve these stories and use Science to explain why people believed this; whether their beliefs are true or not. Finding the truth in the stories is important to knowing who your ancestors wanted you to be.

1631505876384112641.a: It is an existential mistake to believe these ancient stories using our modern understanding of the universe. Their universe was very different from ours. They could still see the sky. Many stories are projected onto the stars to help us remember ourselves when we forget.

1631505877554323456.a: We have millions of words to explain our world. They had maybe hundreds words. We have vast education. They had their ways of knowing. We can teach children their ancestry and science. But I think we need to approach those stories with the same diligence as any scientific study.

1631507175741825025.a: It is worth noting that the foundational myth of The Rosicrucian Order is that of a 2yo boy in Germany during the inquisition. His entire family, tribe, village burned to the ground by the soldiers to genocide them. He escaped and vowed to learn all the knowledge that was stolen.

1631508585241870336.a: I enjoy this telling of the story. It's really not to be taken too seriously if you ask me but the message it conveys I find compelling. My ancestors raised me in this tradition; I was like an alien when I entered the real world. All my mother would say is, "You won't like it."

1631510778099507204.a: e.g. The difference between Alchemy and Chemistry is that Alchemy offers no way to determine why things work they way they work. Could you make a nuclear reactor with Alchemy? Yes. Could you make two? ten? Maybe. Scientific Method allows Alchemy to be explained by Chemistry.

1631533371229712387.a: So, what do we Rosicrucians do with this ancient knowledge melded with Science? Try to heal the discord in the world. Often through our artistic expressions. The knowledge placed into our minds by our teachings manifest in our artwork. Examples? How about a very recent one...
